data.gender_notes: Furayd is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Furayd is an Arabic name that refers to a type of precious stone. It is unisex and has been used for both boys and girls in Islamic culture. It is a spiritual name that embodies the values of worth, beauty, and strength. The name Furayd carries the meaning “A precious stone” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Furayd usually hope their child will grow to embody a precious stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Furayd belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “A precious stone.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furayd total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_urdu.name: فرید
in_urdu.long_meaning: فرید ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب خوشی، خوشگوار اور خوشبو ہے۔ یہ نام ایک خوش اخلاق اور خوش دل شخص کو دکھاتا ہے۔ یہ نام اسلامی تہذیب میں بہت مقبول ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फरीद
in_hindi.long_meaning: फरीद एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ खुशी, सुंदर और प्रिय है। यह नाम एक अच्छे चरित्र और भले स्वभाव वाले व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है। इस्लाम में यह नाम काफी लोकप्रिय है।

in_pashto.name: فرید
in_pashto.long_meaning: فرید یو عربي نوم دی چې معنا یې خوشي، خوشبو او زېږنه دی. دا نوم یو خوشخوړ او مهربان شخص ته ورکول کېږی.

in_english.name: Furayd

Furayd is a popular choice for baby boys in many Muslim cultures, symbolizing a life filled with contentment and positivity.
